exposure: umbilical cord blood pH (arterial and venous)
cohort: The study included 192 pregnant ladies who presented in labor to the maternity ward of a tertiary care teaching hospital.
finding: In high-risk pregnancies, a statistically significant correlation was established between Apgar score at 1 minute and both arterial and venous umbilical cord blood pH, suggesting its utility as a predictor for fetal asphyxia.
